claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: CAS Harness has a validated Qwen2.5-1.5B component-hook adapter for continuation-position attention-head and MLP interventions, unblocking Stage 27P drive-local Qwen eraser-cover steering.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim Qwen steering, cross-architecture control, complete circuits, durable weight edits, open-ended generation control, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27P-A.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27P-A is only a hook-adapter preflight. It proves Qwen component hooks can be applied at the intended positions with finite effects; it does not prove Qwen steering, component attribution, or circuit control.

gates.criterion: Stage 16 Qwen CPL2 PASS, Stage 16 manifest revision match, and Stage 27O PASS source contracts are verified.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: Every candidate layer exposes attention output projection self_attn.o_proj and MLP module mlp.
gates.name: adapter_paths

gates.criterion: A scaled attention-head hook changes logits at prediction positions while leaving earlier positions unchanged.
gates.name: attention_hook_effect

gates.criterion: A scaled MLP hook changes logits at prediction positions while leaving earlier positions unchanged.
gates.name: mlp_hook_effect

method: Commit this pre-registration, adapter, runner, and tests before any Qwen hook result is generated.
Verify Stage 16 Qwen CPL2 PASS and Stage 27O Pythia-1B drive-local steering PASS source contracts.
Inspect candidate late layers 24-27 and verify attention output projection and MLP module paths.
Run one actual CPL2-style prompt/continuation row with no hook, one attention-head scale hook, and one MLP scale hook.
Confirm hooks are continuation-prediction-position localized: positions before the first prediction position remain unchanged.
Confirm each hook changes logits at prediction positions and yields finite continuation log-probabilities.
motivation: Stage 27O closed Pythia cross-scale steering with drive-local output-side eraser covers. Stage 27P moves to Qwen, but Qwen uses different module paths than Pythia. Stage 27P-A validates the hook adapter before any cross-architecture steering claim is attempted.
